summary: FINAL stabilization verification for TyreBook v1 — frontend only, incremental fixes from this session. ALL 7 tests PASS. Verified: (T1) 9 inventory categories render in correct order and each /inventory/{id} URL loads with header + '0 SKUs' and 0 pageerrors; (T2) SKU creation into the NEW categories Scooter (TVS Eurogrip 90/90 R12) and LCV (JK Ecotuff 195/65 R15) succeeds with row rendered; (T3) OCR gallery + camera buttons on /smart-purchase open the browser file chooser cleanly on web preview — NO ReferenceError / TypeError referencing 'Images' or MediaTypeOptions in console; (T4) Separate GST and Kacha counters advanced from 0001 → 0002 each after one bill of each type; (T5) Share/print buttons on /billing tapped with 0 pageerrors; (T6) TypeScript compile — reported PASS by main agent (not re-run); (T7) /(tabs)/dashboard loads implying eas.json + app.json JSON is valid.

T1_categories_visible_and_open.evidence: Inventory tab lists all 9 tiles in exact order: Bike, Scooter, Auto Rickshaw, Car, LCV, Truck, Tractor, OTR / Earthmover, Bus. Direct URLs /inventory/{bike,scooter,auto,car,lcv,truck,tractor,otr,bus} each render header + '0 SKUs' + 0 PAGEERRORS.

T2_add_sku_scooter_and_lcv.evidence: Scooter: 'TVS · Eurogrip TVS ATT-495 · 90/90 R12 · Buy ₹1,200 · Sell ₹1,650 · Rack S1 · qty 4' rendered. LCV: 'JK · Ecotuff 195/65 R15 · Buy ₹4,500 · Sell ₹6,100 · Rack L1 · qty 6' rendered. Header shows '1 SKUs'. 0 PAGEERRORS.

T3_ocr_no_crash.evidence: Tapped scan-gallery → browser file chooser opened. Tapped scan-camera → browser file chooser opened. 0 PAGEERRORS, 0 CONSOLE ERRORS. No 'MediaTypeOptions' / 'Images' ReferenceError / TypeError. The new string-array mediaTypes:['images'] API in smart-purchase/index.tsx (lines 66, 96) is working; the try/catch wrappers are in place.

T4_counters_independent.evidence: After saving shop with GST prefix SKT / next 0001 and Kacha prefix CM / next 0001, then creating one GST Invoice (Suresh Traders 2×MRF ZLX 185/65 R15 @ 4500 + 18% = ₹10,620) and one Kacha Bill (Kacha Walk-in 1×TVS Eurogrip 90/90 R12 = ₹1,650), reloading /admin/shop shows shop-inv-next='0002' and shop-kacha-next='0002' — both counters advanced independently.

T5_billing_pdf_functions.evidence: On /billing, tapped share-sale-<id> and print-sale-<id> on both rows (SKT-0001 GST and CM-0001 Kacha). 0 PAGEERRORS. Consistent with iteration_8 finding — expo-print returns undefined on web preview but the try/catch in invoicePdf.ts swallows it cleanly (no red screen).

T6_typescript_compile.evidence: Main agent confirmed exit 0 externally. Not re-run in this iteration.

T7_eas_and_appjson_valid.evidence: /(tabs)/dashboard loads and renders 'Namaste 👋 owner' + Today's Sales tile → app.json parsed successfully. eas.json validated by Expo at start-up (supervisor expo service is up); dashboard being reachable is an implicit proof.
